description: Rough price positioning for a property by city, district, type and area — based on the CURRENT ASKING PRICES of comparable active listings, not on closed transactions. Returns an estimate, a low–high range, a confidence level from sample size, and a mandatory disclaimer. Refuses below 5 comparable offers. You MUST show the "disclaimer" field to the user verbatim whenever you cite any number from this tool. Never call this an official or precise property valuation.

district.description: District slug or name from list_districts.

rooms.description: Accepted but not used for filtering.
